spans.s:
r. 1st and 6th cls. (घोणति घुणति)
To roll, to whirl, to turn round.
(इ) घुणि r. 1st cl. (घुणते)
To take or accept.

m. (-णः)
1 An insect that is found in timber.
2 The pangolin or armadillo.
E.
घुण to turn round, affix क.

m. (-ण्टः)
The ancle.
E.
घुट to resist, affix क and नुम् inserted; also with कन् added घुण्टक, or without the augment घुट &c. as above.

m. (-ण्डः)
A large black bee.
E.
घुण to roll, Uṇādi affix ड.
